name: Tax Firm OS
tagline: Whole-office copilot for a tax or accounting practice
description: Built for a whole tax or accounting practice rather than a single person. It speeds up client replies, keeps engagement documentation complete, raises deadline warnings early, and pushes work to finish ahead of due dates, giving one assistant a view of the firm's day-to-day load.
author: Amervim
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
